info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Investment Portfolio Statements-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed investment portfolio statements, helping them view their financial performance over a set period. Financial analysts and investors typically utilize this endpoint to obtain current insights on multiple investment portfolios at once. The API supports filtering and sorting options, making it an essential tool for comprehensive investment analysis and reporting. By accessing this data, users can make informed decisions based on the latest portfolio performance metrics.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed statements related to their portfolios, providing insights into investment performance and asset allocation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve portfolio statements based on the specified criteria. It should contain necessary filters or parameters that dictate which portfolio statements to fetch.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested portfolio statements.
